summary.headline: Lord of the Eighth House
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the lord of a planet or point in the sixth through twelfth houses, especially effects on marriage, wives, inheritance, and social status. Chapter XV then interprets the lord of the eighth house in the ascendant and houses two through ten, including bodily weakness, inheritances, family fortunes, sons, and power.
